steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: *Pant* *pant*... Impressive!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: The black raincoats are retreating! Run while you can!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Thanks!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Don't thank us. If you have the strength, you should fight alongside us!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Did you see him swing down from the fourth floor and graze my head like that? If I didn't freeze his weapon with the Originium FrostNova left in my backpack, I wouldn't be standing here!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Very impressive. They're just like the swordsmen in the gas masks back in Ursus. Even stronger, really!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: You almost died, what are you so excited about? The masked swordsmen you're talking about were the Ursus Royal Guard! We only met five of them that time!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Did you count how many raincoats there are?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Does that mean we're even more awesome than before?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: This is not a time for jokes. Their techniques and their equipment mean they must have a city... Even the craftsmen of multiple cities supplying them.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: There's no way we can beat them back on our own. Don't even think about trying to kill them!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: I just... I just think I did pretty well.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: The point is this situation is way beyond what we can handle... We can't hold out for long!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Quiet!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Reporting in.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Sister, these are... Faust's people.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*... I recognize them.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: FrostNova, we received your message, and...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why is Mephisto with you? What happened to him?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Mephisto has taken some... hits to his psyche.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Him? Traumatized?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Wait, where is Faust?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Faust stayed behind to give us, and others, a chance to escape. We left him outside the slums.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's hard to come back from that.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Faust was a brave warrior.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: FrostNova, if we could, we would like to fight alongside the Yetis.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You could. We must get our remaining people out safely.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Find a sniping position and await orders. We will need your support in the coming battle. We don't know when the enemy may attack again.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Pass our location to all teams: We will guarantee a safe route for their retreat from here!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Keep evacuating.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Are they like the Ursus soldiers with a total disregard for collateral damage?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: I don't think so. The Ursus were willing to use direct artillery fire on the upper city!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I knew they were brutal. But that brutal?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: We saw it with our own eyes.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: The raincoat people are very different.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: They see civilians as targets, since they can't tell the difference between Infected and uninfected. They don't know if maybe we're dressing up as civilians.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: The Ursus just didn't care, but these people don't let a single one slip through.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: There are so many fleeing, it's damn near impossible to keep order! FrostNova is in a tough spot!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Sister won't let anyone die. Reunion or no.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: We came to Lungmen to fight. How did we end up saving people? It's funny.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: The fighting is pretty much done. If you guys didn't show up, we'd all be dead!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Man that's crazy. You're really counting on us?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Can you not talk like that...? I used to think you guys were so imposing, but now you just seem like a bunch of clowns.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: You got us all wrong. We just don't talk much. Shouldn't be imposing.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Anyway, aren't we supposed to be holding this place with you?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: You're totally right! Bro, let's defend this place together!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: We... we found some locals locked up in here.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: A mother and daughter. We were going to use the place as a firing position, but we don't know how to communicate with them... They seem pretty scared of us.

steps.name: Lungmenite
steps.text: (Local language)!

steps.name: Lungmenite
steps.text: (Local language) ...... (local language) ......!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: She is your child, yes?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Waaahhh!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Such a healthy one.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Don't be afraid. Don't cry. Your mama is right here.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Mama is here.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Waaahhh...

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Mm... Um... Mm.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Oh, the child is smiling...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Get her out of here.

steps.name: Lungmenite
steps.text: ...... (Local language)?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You *cough* escort her. See her to safety.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: They're uninfected. There are so many of our people who need evacuating. We don't have time.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: ...Right. Who cares whether it's the Infected or the uninfected now? Understood.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Erm, uh, ma'am, um... Komm zis way?

steps.name: Lungmenite
steps.text: Neidei, neidei... hou.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: FrostNova, Sister, wait for us to come back. Don't try to hold on your own.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Have some faith in your big sister.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hurry! They're coming!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: They are deploying some units wearing other uniforms... They might be Lungmen's L. G. D.!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Cough* *cough* ... *hack*.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: The temperature is as low as it will go!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: The uniformed ones are no match for us, but watch out for the raincoats!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Where's Nesti? We need more firepower. We need suppressing fire!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: He says okay!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: I don't think Sister's body can take much more. She can't keep the temperature down!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: We can't break the pavement?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: No way! If we do that, how will our people and the locals get to the exit?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: We're sure this is the only way out?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Yes. The other ones have all been destroyed. All that's left is the one we dug.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: How much time do we have? Or how much time does Sister have?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Why must it come down to tormenting her so?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: They're almost done!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: I'll go get Sister!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Sister, we've just about got this group evacuated!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And the fighting... how goes?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: We've got the L. G. D. completely suppressed. The terrain favors us, and they can't make use of their superior numbers.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: But...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You have nothing to hide.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Lungmen's raincoat brigade doesn't care about the terrain, or the people. They... they're going to level everything.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: They're purging the slums

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And those uninfected Lungmenites we saw...?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: I'm afraid that was their doing.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Sister, stop your Arts! We can handle these ones ourselves. Just rest for a bit!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Sister!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: The temperature just cracked the lower limit!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: She's doing it...! The superstructure is weakening!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Smash their footing and push them back! Fire!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: They're falling back! Keep it up!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Faster! More! Faster!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: R- right!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: That's our big sister! She really did it!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Petrova, what's wrong? Why do you look so gloomy?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: ...Sister?

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Young, come here.

steps.name: Young
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Come!

steps.name: Young
steps.text: I can't!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: You have to. Sister doesn't have much time left.
